verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no Cline-provided isolated cloud environment for background tasks. Its headless CLI, scheduled agents, and Kanban worktrees all run on the user's own machine or pipeline, and running inside GitHub Actions or GitLab relies on the host platform rather than a Cline capability. Missing for 10: a first-party hosted cloud sandbox or VM for agent execution, and documented asynchronous delegation of long-running tasks to that cloud environment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can delegate longer-running coding tasks to run in the background in an isolated cloud environment
